channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Routine Patrolling Leads to Arrest of ATM Fraud Accused in Delhi
item.description: Delhi Police on Saturday arrested two accused allegedly involved in ATM fraud in the South-West District.

item.title: Two Maoists neutralised in ongoing encounter in Chhattisgarh’s Bijapur
item.description: The encounter began at 5.00 a.m. when a team from the District Reserve Guard (DRG) came under exchange of fire during a search operation in the South Bastar forests.

item.title: 14 NCP Leaders Resign After Party Ties Up with Jamaat-e-Islami
item.description: Simultaneously, a debate has emerged in the political circles over the income disclosed in the election affidavit of NCP convener Nahid Islam, Bangladeshi Bengali daily Jugantor reported.

item.title: Dilip Kumar Predicted It Right: Subhash Ghai on Anupam Kher’s Longevity
item.description: As veteran actor Anupam Kher is celebrating doing his 550th film, "Khosla Ka Ghosla 2", filmmaker Subhash Ghai recalled what Bollywood legend said about Kher during the shoot of their film "Karma".

item.title: BCCI has instructed KKR to release Bangladesh pacer Mustafizur Rahman: Devajit Saikia
item.description: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) secretary Devajit Saikia said that the board has formally asked Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) to release Bangladesh pace spearhead Mustafizur Rahman from their squad ahead of the IPL 2026 season, ending weeks of controversy surrounding the high-profile signing.

item.title: Bharat Ratnas Honoured: Delhi Assembly Celebrates India’s Democracy and Culture
item.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh will unveil portraits of Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Bharat Ratna Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya at the Delhi Legislative Assembly on Saturday.

item.title: SIR in Bengal: Voters from 3 aboriginal tribes to be automatically enlisted
item.description: Following the Commission's instruction, the District Magistrates, as well as the District Electoral Officers, have asked the Block Development Officers (BDOs) to provide details of the voters from these three aboriginal tribes in their respective areas.

item.title: On Paush Purnima, first ‘Wolf Supermoon’ to light up the sky today
item.description: Paush Purnima, the first full moon of the Hindu lunar calendar in 2026 will be observed on Saturday, coinciding with a spectacular celestial event, the year’s first supermoon which is also being called the 'Wolf Supermoon'.

item.title: Kerala Assembly Polls 2026: UDF Gears Up Amid Seat-Sharing Challenges
item.description: With the Kerala Assembly elections expected in April-May, the Congress-led United Democratic Front (UDF) has entered a crucial phase of preparations, buoyed by renewed confidence but confronted by familiar internal challenges.

item.title: Bengal govt to fianlise draft of state ‘Antibiotic Action Plan’ next week
item.description: The West Bengal Health Department has scheduled a crucial meeting on January 9 to finalise the draft of the State Antibiotic Action Plan, aimed at curbing the rampant use of antibiotics and tackling antimicrobial resistance across the state.
